secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI (Gemini) API key for the Volt 360 AI Assistant, roof scan panel detection, and utility bill analysis. Optional at boot — without it the app starts and the AI features report 'not configured'.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps/Cloud API key for the Solar API roof data and satellite tiles, also served to the browser for map display. Optional at boot — without it the roof scan reports 'not configured'.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for sending booking notification emails. Create a free account at resend.com and generate an API key. Without it, bookings are still stored and logged to Google Sheets, but no email alert is sent.

secrets.name: NOTIFICATION_EMAIL
secrets.description: The email address where you want to receive instant alerts whenever someone books a meeting through your scheduling tool.

secrets.name: REGRID_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Regrid API token for the parcel layer on the map (owner, acreage, zoning and parcel number pins). Copy it from your Regrid account dashboard at regrid.com (Account -> API tokens). Optional at boot — without it the map's Parcels button reports that Regrid is not connected.
